title: fix(app-shell): Assigned users shows the position note beside a direct grant read with no id
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XTWEjq6iztvdN4L3b47CGgf)_

Fixes #32868

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

Seat `domain:ui#1` · os-project-manager · card thread `session_01FEkQ5moEGLpykFoy7qJkXT` · claim 6882331283

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：权限集「已分配用户」里，某人既有一条没有 id 的直接授权、又经岗位持有时，这一行现在显示「经岗位持有」提示（仍不显示移除）。Add 选择里「本环境自己的权限集」按钮的行为不变，只把它在两条目录路径上的服务端答复写进文档并各钉一条测试。
- 为什么改：卡片 #32868 的两条复读问题。第二条是界面缺口，已修；第一条实测后发现：注册表不持有该名、目录退回元数据服务时，环境按钮按名重发会被服务端拒绝（只点名两个包），页面把这次拒绝显示成下一次选择，不会按顺序替人选。
- 风险与回滚：只动 `@object-ui/app-shell` 一个组件的一处条件，不发新请求、不放宽服务端判定。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`AssignedUsersSection.tsx` 行尾提示的条件；新测试文件 `AssignedUsersSection.fallbackPick-32868.test.tsx`。
- 两分钟验证：在 `ui/` 下跑 `pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/AssignedUsersSection.fallbackPick-32868.test.tsx`，预期 4 个全过。
- 第一条已收口：席位按派单第二条裁定 A（元数据服务路径上，环境按钮被拒后转为下一次选择，理由用服务端原话，不按顺序选持有者），两条路径都有钉子，不开服务端卡。

## What changes

**Item 2 (fixed).** In the Assigned users list, a row with no removable grant shows the "Held via a position" hint whenever a position holds the set, whatever the shape of the person's direct grant. FROM: a direct grant read with no `id`, beside a position, gave a row with neither Remove nor the hint. TO: no Remove, and the hint. Unchanged: a position-only row (hint), an id-less direct-only row (neither), a removable direct grant (Remove, no hint).

**Item 1 (measured; no behaviour change; documentation and pins).** The environment's button on the Add pick re-sends the grant by the name alone. Re-measured on `main` e0ce1b52, after #32867 (PR #33252), with a real `MetadataManager` in-memory store, a real `createSecurityCatalogReader` over a registry that holds the name nowhere (the metadata-service fallback), and the real `judgeGrantSet`:

| Store state (save order) | Catalog holders listed | Grant naming a non-holder | Bare re-send (the environment's button) |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| env, crm, hr (env saved last) | crm, hr, env | 409 `not-held-by-qualifier` naming crm, hr, environment | 409 `ambiguous-in-environment` naming crm, hr only |
| env, crm, hr (env saved first) | crm, hr | 409 naming crm, hr | 409 naming crm, hr |
| crm, env (env saved last) | env | 409 naming environment | stored, the environment's set |
| env, crm (env saved first) | crm | 409 naming crm | stored, crm's set |
| env only | env | 409 naming environment | stored, the environment's set |

So the environment is offered beside packages on that path in one state only (two packages, the environment's row saved last), and there its re-send is refused, naming the packages. The section shows that refusal as the next pick, in the server's words, with the users still to grant: the environment is no longer offered, nothing is sent until a holder is clicked, and no holder is chosen by order. On the registry path the environment's own set answers the name alone, and the re-send is stored (CONTROL). The section's doc for `addUsers` now says this instead of leaving it implied.

The card's ruling asks for one of two outcomes on the fallback: the environment re-send is accepted there (pinned), or the pick is not offered there with the reason said. Neither holds as measured: the re-send is refused, and the page cannot tell the fallback from the registry path before it sends (the refusal's candidates are the same shape on both). Making it accepted needs a server change (the metadata store's bare read would answer the environment's own row beside package slots, as the registry path does), which the order rules out. The seat ruled this inside the order's second arm (ruling A, card comment 6883009319): the refusal withdraws the environment from the next pick and gives the server's reason, so item 1 is closed by the pins.

Changeset `.changeset/32868-holder-pick-fallback-position-note.md`: `@object-ui/app-shell` patch and `@object-ui/console` patch (the console's `dist` ships the app shell; app-shell itself is private).

## Tests

New `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/AssignedUsersSection.fallbackPick-32868.test.tsx`, rendered through the real section with events (Add, the picker, the pick buttons, the Remove confirm):

- item 1, metadata-service fallback: the first user granted, the second refused `not-held-by-qualifier` naming crm, hr and the environment; the environment's button re-sends by name, is refused `ambiguous-in-environment` naming crm and hr; the next pick has two buttons and no environment; nothing more is sent until HR is clicked, which sends the grant naming HR;
- item 1, CONTROL registry path: the environment's re-send is stored for every user still to grant;
- item 2: an id-less direct grant beside a position shows both chips, the hint, and no Remove;
- item 2, CONTROL one holder: position-only row keeps the hint; id-less direct-only row shows neither; a removable direct grant beside a position keeps its Remove (by its id) and shows no hint.

## Acceptance notes

- Item 1 was an open question in the report; the seat ruled A (card comment 6883009319), so the body says `Fixes #32868`.
- The state where a bare read answers a package's set although the catalog listed the environment as a holder (env saved first, then one package: the package's write replaces the environment's slot) does not offer the environment button: the catalog then lists the package only. Measured above.
- `permission-set-holder.ts`'s module doc still says the environment's own set is addressed by the name alone; that holds on the registry path only. The file is outside the claim's surface, so it is noted here, not edited.
- Not measured: the database loader's rows on a booted environment kernel (the probe used the in-memory store, as #33252's own note leaves open).

## Verification

<details><summary>Item 1 probe (scratch test, deleted, not committed)</summary>

A throwaway vitest file in `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/` (real `MetadataManager.registerInMemory`, real `createSecurityCatalogReader` over a registry serving no permission set, real `judgeGrantSet`), run on e0ce1b52 after building the `@objectstack/plugin-security^...` closure. Output, verbatim:

```
## env + crm + hr (env saved first)
  store list: crm:com.acme.crm hr:com.acme.hr
  catalog holders: com.acme.crm, com.acme.hr
  grant naming com.acme.other: refused not-held-by-qualifier [com.acme.crm, com.acme.hr]
  bare re-send (environment pick): refused ambiguous-in-environment [com.acme.crm, com.acme.hr]
## env + crm + hr (env saved last)
  store list: crm:com.acme.crm hr:com.acme.hr env:-
  catalog holders: com.acme.crm, com.acme.hr, ENV
  grant naming com.acme.other: refused not-held-by-qualifier [com.acme.crm, com.acme.hr, environment]
  bare re-send (environment pick): refused ambiguous-in-environment [com.acme.crm, com.acme.hr]
## env + crm (env first)
  store list: crm:com.acme.crm
  catalog holders: com.acme.crm
  grant naming com.acme.other: refused not-held-by-qualifier [com.acme.crm]
  bare re-send (environment pick): resolved com.acme.crm (label crm)
## env + crm (env last)
  store list: env:-
  catalog holders: ENV
  grant naming com.acme.other: refused not-held-by-qualifier [environment]
  bare re-send (environment pick): resolved ENV (label env)
## env only
  store list: env:-
  catalog holders: ENV
  grant naming com.acme.other: refused not-held-by-qualifier [environment]
  bare re-send (environment pick): resolved ENV (label env)
```
</details>

| Baseline at HEAD | 10 / 10 |

The first ABL-1 attempt replaced the ternary head only and was a parse error (no tests ran); it is void, not a reading, and the retry above is the one counted.
